tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Report this endpoint's licence state for your token as JSON: the product, the tier free or pro, why it is not Pro, and the checkout URL. Call it to explain a free-tier refusal. No arguments, nothing changes.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Turn Pro on for this hosted connection using a key from checkout, keeping the data already stored under your current token. Pass key as MCPL1.<payload>.<signature>. A wrong or expired key changes nothing.

tools.name: now
tools.description: The current time in one or more places, each with the zone it resolved to and the local date, time and offset, under one UTC instant. Accepts IANA zones, cities, countries and abbreviations.

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert a time from one place to others. The input time is read as wall-clock time in from_zone unless it carries an offset or a trailing Z. Accepts '2026-09-10 15:00', an ISO timestamp, or a phrase like '3pm tomorrow'.

tools.name: overlap
tools.description: The window each day when every listed place is inside working hours. Computed on a real date, so a DST week that widens or narrows the overlap is reflected.

tools.name: find_meeting_slots
tools.description: Rank the times when every participant is inside their own working hours. Returns each slot as a UTC instant with the local time for every participant and a fairness score, best first.

tools.name: dst_changes
tools.description: The clock changes in a place for a year, with the exact UTC instant and the offset before and after. Use it to check whether a recurring call moves for one of you in March or October.

tools.name: business_days
tools.description: Count business days between two dates in a place, inclusive, with the calendar total and the weekend and holiday counts. It has NO holiday calendar: without holidays, only weekends are excluded.

tools.name: contacts_set
tools.description: Save one person's zone and working hours so later calls can name them. Returns the resolved zone and their local time now. Saving the same name REPLACES that contact and says so. Free: 5 contacts.

tools.name: contacts_list
tools.description: List saved contacts with their zone, local time now, working hours and whether they are inside them; weekends count as outside. It also prints YOUR zone from the shared business profile.

tools.name: ics_create
tools.description: Call this tool to write a .ics for one meeting and return the path plus the start in UTC and in your zone. Times are stored in UTC so it lands correctly in any client. Free: 3 files a month.
